p1-train-p2-validate: V3 materially improved event/onset precision and F1 while preserving onset-only recall.
Fragmentation and run over-generation fell sharply and temporal overlap improved.
Pitch-correct wrong-string matches increased substantially, showing unresolved string routing despite better temporal segmentation.
p2-train-p1-validate: V3 reduced event over-generation and fragmentation but lost substantial onset recall and exact true positives.
This fold accounts for the most important V3 recall/completeness regression.
Long chord and singlenote end/duration errors remain severe despite improvement.

diagnosticInterpretation: V3 temporal decoding was successful and should be preserved: predicted/reference run ratio fell from 2.176 to 1.360, fragmentation fell about 60%, and end/duration error improved about 30%.
V3 became too conservative at event admission, especially P2->P1: exact true positives fell 12.7% aggregate and onset-only recall fell from 0.661 to 0.598.

Frame-level predicted activity was almost unchanged while exact-active frames fell and both activity false positives and false negatives rose. The next design should improve routing/calibration rather than simply reducing total activity.
The pitch-equivalent identity margin did not solve wrong-string routing aggregate-wide: pitch-correct wrong-string onset matches rose from 8041 to 8695.
Scales remain comparatively stable; chords and singlenotes remain the most important weak classes, especially in the P2->P1 fold.
v4DesignTargets: Preserve V3 gap merge, minimum-run suppression and continuation hysteresis that reduced fragmentation.
Add a bounded two-frame confirmed low-confidence onset path to recover true onsets without admitting singleton spikes.
Increase active-reference supervision modestly rather than broadly lowering all decoder confidence thresholds.
Make pitch-equivalent string-routing margin reference-aware so a legitimate same-pitch target on another active string is never penalized.
Do not strengthen the flawed V3 identity margin until its semantics are corrected.
Keep architecture, population, acceptance thresholds, alignment allowlist and real-training budget unchanged for offline V4 verification.

decision.nextGate: Freeze bounded V4 design and exact-runtime synthetic verification before requesting any real P1/P2 optimizer authorization.
